class.name: OcgGraphic3dText
class.brief_description: This class allows the definition of a text object for display. The text might be defined in one of ways, using: - text value and position, - text value, orientation and the state whether the text uses position as point of attach. - text formatter. Formatter contains text, height and alignment parameter.
class.description: ! This class allows the definition of a text object for display. ! The text might be defined in one of ways, using: ! - text value and position, ! - text value, orientation and the state whether the text uses position as point of attach. ! - text formatter. Formatter contains text, height and alignment parameter. ! ! This class also has parameters of the text height and H/V alignments. ! Custom formatting is available using Font_TextFormatter.

method.name: TextFormatter
method.description: Returns text formatter; NULL by default, which means standard text formatter will be used.

method.name: SetTextFormatter
method.description: Setup text default formatter for text within this context.

method.name: Position
method.description: The 3D point of attachment is projected. If the orientation is defined, the text is written in the plane of projection.

method.name: HasPlane
method.description: Returns true if the text is filled by a point

method.name: HasOwnAnchorPoint
method.description: Returns true if the text has an anchor point

method.name: SetOwnAnchorPoint
method.description: Returns true if the text has an anchor point

method.name: Height
method.description: Sets height of text. (Relative to the Normalized Projection Coordinates (NPC) Space).
